task_definition.task_description: Please find some alternative audio options to the black Sony XM5, then pick the silver Sony XM5 and prepare an order for 2 units. After that, check my available coupons, apply the best discount, generate a PayPal invoice for the order and send it to alice@company.com, then get the latest business news and send me an in-app alert to Alice saying that the invoice has been generated successfully.

user_input.query: Please look for some alternative audio options to the black Sony XM5 with product_id p_sony_xm5_blk in the audio category for user_id user_123. Then choose the silver Sony XM5 with selected_product product_id p_sony_xm5_slv and prepare an order for quantity 2 with medium priority. After that, check my available coupons, including coupon_code SAVE15, apply the best discount, generate a PayPal invoice using paypal, and send it to Alice at alice@company.com. Then get the latest business news in the business category, and send an app alert through the app channel to recipient_name Alice with the message: "Your invoice has been generated successfully."
